content: Client-Side Vulnerabilities: Audit Reflected/Stored/DOM XSS. Inspect unsafe sources (location.search, location.hash) flowing into dangerous sinks (innerHTML, eval). Audit CORS misconfigurations with reflected Origin headers and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true.

Server-Side Flaws: Test SQL Injection (Time-based, Blind, Union, OOB). Test SSRF against cloud metadata endpoints (169.254.169.254). Test IDOR and BOLA/BFLA in REST/GraphQL APIs by swapping user resource IDs.
